name: Equipped Strike (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite: Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefit: Weapons designed to be strapped to your hands or feet such as blade boots, climbing claws, sea knives or spiked gauntlets, count as Monk weapons for you, and you can apply the effects of feats that have Improved Unarmed Strike as a prerequisite to attacks made with such weapons.
